Spider Overview
Spider
is a unique
Beast Form
that can only be attained by drinking the
Spider Juice
potion sold by the
Strange Spider
, who is trapped deep in
Serbule Crypt
. Getting out of the form is done the same way, but with the far more expensive
Un-Spider Juice
.
Spiders serve the Goddess of Spiders and Patience,
Akhisa
.
In-Game Description
The art of living and fighting as a spider.
Training Spider
Strange Spider
will sell you a potion to turn into a Spider. BE WARNED, THIS IS PERMANENT UNTIL DISPELLED.
Strange Spider
also happens to sell a potion to undo being a Spider. If turning Spider, it might be a good idea to pick up one of these, too, so you can un-Spider when you want.
Some NPCs, even if they will talk to most animals, will not talk to scary ones. Spiders are quite scary.
Strange Spider also sells scrolls which teach a variety of spider abilities: Various levels of
Spit Acid
,
Insidious Illusion
, and
Incubate
.
Legs
in
Animal Town
will unlock Spider levels 51-60, 61-70 and can teach you level 51+ abilities.
Noita the Green
unlocks Spider levels 71-80.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Big Footed Jim
deep beneath
Povus
.
